records.evidence: UBA Kiddies Account It is never too early to get started on saving for your child. Open a UBA Kiddies Savings Account and enjoy amazing benefits that secures your baby’s future. Available for children from 0 – 12 years Benefits •4 % interest per annum paid quarterly

UBA Teens Account Start them while they are young to secure their financial stability. The UBA Teens Savings account is designed for children between 13 – 17 years. Benefits •4 % interest per annum paid quarterly

UBA NextGen Account The UBA NextGen Savings Account is uniquely designed for young adults between 18 – 35 years. It is tailored to build financial freedom for youths, providing an account that enables them to save. Benefits •4 % interest per annum paid quarterly

UBA Freedom Account Take the first step towards managing your money better and experience financial freedom. The UBA Freedom Savings Account is designed to encourage the unbanked to open a savings account with low KYC. Benefits • 3% Interest per annum paid quarterly

UBA Bumper Account This is an account for salary earners, professionals, students, entrepreneurs and all other individuals.The UBA Bumper Savings Account is a hybrid of savings and current account which gives customers the desired benefit derived from both accounts. Benefits • 5 % interest per annum paid quarterly
